mapper.select: SELECT id, username, username_normalized AS normalizedUsername, display_name AS displayName, status, failed_login_count AS failedLoginCount, locked_until AS lockedUntil, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_user WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, identity_sub AS identitySub, credential_type AS credentialType, password_hash AS passwordHash, password_changed_at AS passwordChangedAt, must_change_password AS mustChangePassword, status, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_user_credential WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, tenant_code AS tenantCode, tenant_name AS tenantName, status, settings, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM public.identity_tenant WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, identity_sub AS identitySub, status, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy FROM public.identity_tenant_membership WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, event_type AS eventType, actor_sub AS actorSub, target_sub AS targetSub, tenant_id AS tenantId, source_ip AS sourceIp, user_agent AS userAgent, result, reason, trace_id AS traceId, payload, occurred_at AS occurredAt FROM public.identity_audit_log WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT client_id AS clientId, app_id AS appId, client_name AS clientName, client_type AS clientType, status, pkce_required AS pkceRequired, access_token_ttl_seconds AS accessTokenTtlSeconds, refresh_token_ttl_seconds AS refreshTokenTtlSeconds, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_client WHERE client_id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY client_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT client_id AS clientId, app_id AS appId, client_name AS clientName, client_type AS clientType, status, pkce_required AS pkceRequired, access_token_ttl_seconds AS accessTokenTtlSeconds, refresh_token_ttl_seconds AS refreshTokenTtlSeconds, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_client WHERE client_id = #{clientId}

SELECT id, client_id AS clientId, resource_server_id AS resourceServerId, grant_type AS grantType, grant_context AS grantContext, tenant_id AS tenantId, allowed_scopes AS allowedScopes, status, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_client_resource_grant WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, resource_server_id AS resourceServerId, resource_uri AS resourceUri, biz_code AS bizCode, app_code AS appCode, environment, display_name AS displayName, management_client_id AS managementClientId, rbac_application_code AS rbacApplicationCode, entry_permission_code AS entryPermissionCode, status, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_resource_server WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, resource_server_id AS resourceServerId, resource_uri AS resourceUri, biz_code AS bizCode, app_code AS appCode, environment, display_name AS displayName, management_client_id AS managementClientId, rbac_application_code AS rbacApplicationCode, entry_permission_code AS entryPermissionCode, status, version, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM public.identity_resource_server WHERE resource_server_id = #{resourceServerId}

SELECT id, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, event_type AS eventType, status, attempt_count AS attemptCount, next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt, created_at AS createdAt, published_at AS publishedAt FROM public.identity_outbox_event WHERE id > COALESCE(#{lastSourceId}, '') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.identity_client_secret
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.identity_signing_key
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.identity_user WHERE id = #{identitySub}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.identity_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT status FROM public.identity_tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId}
SELECT * FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_user WHERE tenant_id = #{partitionId} AND identity_sub = #{identitySub} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_credential WHERE tenant_id = #{partitionId} AND legacy_id = #{legacyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_tenant WHERE tenant_id = #{partitionId} AND identity_tenant_id = #{identityTenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_membership WHERE tenant_id = #{partitionId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT * FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_audit WHERE tenant_id = #{partitionId} AND event_id = #{eventId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_user (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, identity_sub, username, username_normalized, display_name, status, failed_login_count, locked_until, last_login_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.createUserId}, #{row.updateTime}, #{row.updateUserId}, #{row.deletedAt}, #{row.identitySub}, #{row.username}, #{row.usernameNormalized}, #{row.displayName}, #{row.status}, #{row.failedLoginCount}, #{row.lockedUntil}, #{row.lastLoginAt})

INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_credential (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, legacy_id, identity_sub, credential_type, password_hash, password_changed_at, must_change_password, status) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.createUserId}, #{row.updateTime}, #{row.updateUserId}, #{row.deletedAt}, #{row.legacyId}, #{row.identitySub}, #{row.credentialType}, #{row.passwordHash}, #{row.passwordChangedAt}, #{row.mustChangePassword}, #{row.status})

INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_tenant (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, identity_tenant_id, tenant_code, tenant_name, status, settings) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.createUserId}, #{row.updateTime}, #{row.updateUserId}, #{row.deletedAt}, #{row.identityTenantId}, #{row.tenantCode}, #{row.tenantName}, #{row.status}, #{row.settings, typeHandler=top.egon.cola.platform.tianquan.shoubing.admin.tenant.dao.IdentityTenantSettingsJsonbTypeHandler})

INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_identity_membership (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, membership_id, identity_tenant_id, identity_sub, status) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.createUserId}, #{row.updateTime}, #{row.updateUserId}, #{row.deletedAt}, #{row.membershipId}, #{row.identityTenantId}, #{row.identitySub}, #{row.status})

INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_audit (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, event_id, event_type, subject_ref, client_ref, token_ref, resource_ref, result, reason_code, trace_id, occurred_at, payload, audit_kind, public_id, actor_sub, target_sub, identity_tenant_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.tenantId}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.createUserId}, #{row.updateTime}, #{row.updateUserId}, #{row.deletedAt}, #{row.eventId}, #{row.eventType}, #{row.subjectRef}, #{row.clientRef}, #{row.tokenRef}, #{row.resourceRef}, #{row.result}, #{row.reasonCode}, #{row.traceId}, #{row.occurredAt}, CAST(#{row.payload, typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{row.auditKind}, #{row.publicId}, #{row.actorSub}, #{row.targetSub}, #{row.identityTenantId})
